name: Nicolás Amelio-Ortiz
bio: Screenwriter and director born in Buenos Aires in 1991, Nicolás Amelio Ortiz premiered his debut film, El bosque de los submitidos, in 2012. He is also the author of the short films El Suplicio (2013), Música para Elegidos (2014), La Hoguera (2016), and Virgen (2017, screened at the 50th Sitges International Festival, shortly after its launch in Argentina). Nicolás is also the creator and director of ZEPfilms, a producer of digital content mainly dedicated to cinema. ZEPfilms has more than one million subscribers on YouTube, and its ZEPfilms DIRECTO podcast is currently one of the most followed in the Spanish language.

credits.title: GDL
credits.overview: GDL is a Mexican dark comedy-drama film set in Guadalajara. We meet Daniel Lurdez, a young man who, after arriving in the city, ends up in a psychologist’s office. credits.title: Virgin
credits.overview: Vanessa and Mathias hide in a house far away from the city to have their first time as a teenage couple. They don't realize an ominous entity is watching them from the deepest of darkness.

credits.title: The Bonfire
credits.overview: Noticing that a storm is coming, Roque and Macarena return from an afternoon of fishing. In the darkness of the road, they discover a bonfire lit among the trees.

credits.title: The Nerd Citizen
credits.overview: A documentary following a YouTuber/director, four Quidditch players and a Tarantino-themed band, trying to change the meaning of what being a nerd is.

credits.title: Music for the Chosen
credits.overview: During a rainy night on their apartment, two girls hear the notes of a piano vibrating on the upper floor. One of them goes upstairs to find out where the melody comes from and faces a series of paranormal events.

credits.title: The Torture
credits.overview: During their summer vacation, Victoria and her boyfriend Leo check out a country house and prepare it for a party. Upon arrival, they discover the facade in very poor condition and, while they organize the disorder, an intruder begins to stalk them.

credits.title: The Flaying
credits.overview: Four teenage friends go on a road trip through Argentina. On their way, they find a castle left abandoned in the middle of a forest. They decide to investigate further, only to discover it's gruesome secrets and former residents.
